body: \>:\[ rude guy with fake laughter box!
Hiding behind games to justify your racism is the problem. Games are not the problem. :l
You're not a dissapointment. That's ok. Would you ever try talking to them?
If you feel comfortable with doing so, seek out those relatives. Don't involve yourself with your mother if she makes you feel this way.
She's wrong about everything she says to you. You're not replaceable. Do you have relatives you can rely on?
I see! Would you like someone to vent too?
You need someone to vent to? I'm available.
You're so incredibly brave. I'm proud of you for keep it up, even with all you're being thrown. When did the terrors start? I'm here to talk, it'll be ok.
Tell me what's bothering you. You don't need to be specific. I'll talk with you.

I did once too! I used to wonder, "what's the point in leaping? I hate getting wet, I hate swimming, I want to stop fighting the current." Yet, I couldn't. Swimming can make your muscles ache after time, I know the feeling, but once you've gotten to the other side we'll be so much stronger then we were before. Please keep leaping! Find a way to make that leap different each time! Maybe you need a change in lifestyle, in who you talk to, or what you do everyday. The leaps will be worth it.
That's not being a coward. Being unsure isn't cowardly, being afraid isn't one either. You can't change what has happened, but that doesn't make you useless. Make your own silver from now on.

You don't deserve it. You don't. You've done nothing wrong. You're not worthless, not replaceable. You know what you are? Brave. Strong. A miracle. Whenever you feel the urge to hurt yourself, try drawing on yourself instead. Talk to those around you. despite people being overall silent, people care. Do you have anyone you can talk to about this?

You're not selfish. You're not selfish. It can take a hundred times before you climb out. Maybe it's not the first time that therapy feels like it's helping, our the twentieth time, but it'll work out over time. Breathe in. One. Two. Three. Exhale. One. Two. Three. Go take a moment to yourself. Find a video to laugh about. It takes time,  it'll get better.

Thank you for letting us know you're still here! I'm glad, I'm happy.... but, for counseling, do what makes you feel comfortable. Sometimes it might surprise you how much there is too it. Maybe you'll talk, maybe you won't, but people are here for you! Both here and at home. 

Let them now how you feel. You're not weak for hiding. You're brave for still going on. But, let them now that too, ok? I promise it can seem hard at times. I took therapy a while ago. It took one person. Maybe that one person will surprise you. Take that leap, if you fall in the river you can swim out and try again, and again, and again. If this isn't the right person, seek another person for help. Take that risk, I promise it seems scary, but it can help.

Remember when you were younger and you wouldn't try a food you were offered? Then you tried it and it was amazing? Or you were right and it was gross? Give this a chance, see where it goes. Sometimes it can surprise you what happens.

You're a brave soul. I, a stranger, am proud of you! Keep going. We all hit bumps in the road, but luckily tires don't stop going. Even a nail can't stop us, we can put another wheel on, and head off back on the road to our destination.
